procedure: Present one guided-choice question at a time, with optional specific custom text. Never ask an open-ended-only question. Do not ask Tommy Kate to restate the recovered identity/visual contract.
Do not treat a refusal, objection, or No selection as a preference answer. Do not call recovered visual directions original questionnaire answers.
Persist each individual answer immediately using profile.save; read back exact value and revision.
Recovered direct instructions use source_kind=recovered_direct_instruction, answered_at=null, recorded_at=ingestion timestamp and explicit source evidence.
Ask only unresolved user preferences; inspect technical capabilities and files yourself. Never ask the founder to guess them.
Every step reads the current saved profile and records every answer disposition with concrete request/output evidence.
Use visual_pilot scope only for private BASIC/STYLED/LIFESTYLE/graphics. Production retains complete setup gate.
One three-role mini test per actual category; inspect each role before proceeding; preserve defects and failures.
No customer release until actual end-to-end evidence passes.

ordered_customer_questions.prompt: What kind of Amazon finds business are you building, and who do you want to reach?
Which product categories do you want to cover?
Would you rather supply detailed product examples, share vibe pictures, or start with a short description?
Describe the overall look you want, including how simple or detailed it should feel.
Which colors, materials and textures should appear, and which should be avoided?
What interests, places or signature details should make these images feel like your brand?
What must never appear in your images?
For your selected categories, what styles, uses, seasons or occasions should guide the products?
Are there product types, materials, brands or features you want excluded?
What price range or value priorities apply to the selected categories?
Do you want an authorized AI persona appearing in lifestyle images, or the no-persona path?
If using a persona, which real-life settings and activities fit your brand?
How should your writing sound, and what wording should it avoid?
Are you an approved Influencer with a storefront, Associates-only, or still setting up?
Which owned storefront, list or website should the content send shoppers to?
Which channels do you want included?
Which parts should the agent handle and which parts do you prefer to do manually?
Which image provider do you want to use? The operator will verify its exact model and supported execution path.
How many looks do you want, and on which days?
Which timezone should govern the schedule?
What finite generation budget and retry allowance do you authorize?
